event.default_and_payoff_same_month: ambiguous_event_order; quarantine from primary labeled sample
event.event_time: first qualifying reporting/event month; never backdated
event.name: first observed composite adverse mortgage event
event.unrecognized_codes: fail closed; require reviewed protocol revision

ambiguous_event_order.rule: same-month default/payoff or unresolved event/exit contradiction

competing_payoff.rule: verified payoff before default; facility risk ends; retain competing cause and time

insufficient_followup.rule: risk interval or coverage cannot be established

negative_survived_horizon.rule: 12 consecutive ascertainable non-event follow-up months without unresolved exit

not_incident_risk_eligible.rule: qualifying event at/before t0, insufficient lookback or unresolved pre-t0 history

positive_default.rule: valid first event in offsets 1..12 before competing payoff and any earlier ascertainment gap

right_censored.rule: administrative cutoff, non-default sales/defect exit or first unknown/gap before horizon; retain last confirmed risk interval

pilot_plan.archive_scope: one official sample-vintage archive only, after separate acquisition authorization
pilot_plan.purpose: engineering and temporal leakage tests only; no empirical performance claim
pilot_plan.retain: all available monthly histories for selected identifiers, including events, exits, unknowns and gaps
pilot_plan.selection: lowest SHA256 values of UTF-8 protocol_id + colon + provider loan identifier; no outcome-based selection

prohibited_claims: exact daily DPD or default date
historically available features from latest-release dates alone

selection.development_source: Freddie Mac Single-Family Loan-Level Standard Dataset
selection.external_replication_candidate: Fannie Mae Primary SF Loan Performance
selection.selection_level: restricted research design; access and record-level quality gates pending
